scope: Python unsigned-64 range reference fixture; not C overflow, ABI, kernel or native illumos validation

contract.specification: Write range_within_u64(start: int, length: int, limit: int) -> bool. Inputs are integers. Return False if any input is outside unsigned 64-bit range 0..18446744073709551615. Otherwise return whether the half-open range [start, start+length) fits within [0, limit). An empty range at start==limit is valid. Reject start>limit even for an empty range. Use the overflow-safe comparison length <= limit - start after checking start <= limit. Use only integer/bool literals, comparisons, boolean operators, subtraction, if and return.
